recommendation_summary: Act now: defer the Odoo rollout and use the existing shared list as a preparation queue sorted by pickup date and time. Today, staff prepare the outstanding cakes due today in that order and update their status so the owner can confirm each one is ready before pickup. Optional additions: none. Unmet needs: none significant, though the reply does not explicitly name a daily due-today view for the morning baker.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need every cake due today prepared before pickup; you proposed Odoo to prevent missed pickups.
labels.Deleted: New sales, inventory and manufacturing modules from this fix; payments and stock already reconcile correctly.
labels.Bottleneck: Preparation is happening out of pickup order, despite everyone having access to the orders.
labels.Checked myself: Only your account: cakes due today remain unmade while next month’s orders have been prepared.

note: Bounded fix using the existing list sorted by pickup date; Deleted unambiguously removes the proposed Odoo modules, and Odoo is deferred rather than offered now.
